source_title: LAWSUIT UPDATE: BellRing Brands, Inc. (NYSE: BRBR) Investors Should Contact the Shareholders Foundation
source_excerpt:
SAN DIEGO , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Shareholders Foundation, Inc. announces an update in the pending lawsuit filed on behalf of certain investors in BellRing Brands, Inc. (NYSE: BRBR ).
NOTICE: Investors who purchased BellRing Brands, Inc. (NYSE: BRBR ) shares before November 19, 2024, and continue to hold any of those shares may have certain legal options. These investors should contact the Shareholders Foundation at [email protected] or call +1 (858) 779-1554.
On January 22, 2026, an investor filed a lawsuit against BellRing Brands, Inc. alleging violations of securities laws. The complaint alleges that the defendants made false and/or misleading statements and/or failed to disclose material information regarding the company's reported sales.
Specifically, the complaint alleges that BellRing's reported sales between November 19, 2024, and August 4, 2025, were materially attributable to temporary inventory stockpiling by several key customers. According to the complaint, this inventory buildup concealed an erosion of BellRing's market share as competition intensified.
The complaint further alleges that, contrary to the defendants' repeated representations, the strong sales results did not reflect increased end-consumer demand or stronger brand momentum. Instead, customers allegedly accumulated excess inventory as a safeguard against product shortages that had previously constrained BellRing's supply. Once customers became confident that those shortages had ended, they reportedly reduced their inventory by selling existing products and cutting back on new orders.
An amended complaint was filed on May 8, 2026. The defendants subsequently filed a motion to dismiss the case.
On July 28, 2026, the court granted in part and denied in part the defendants' motion to dismiss, allowing certain claims to proceed while dismissing others.
Investors who purchased BellRing Brands, Inc. (NYSE: BRBR ) shares should contact the Shareholders Foundation, Inc. to learn more about their potential options.
CONTACT: Shareholders Foundation, Inc. Michael Daniels +1 (858) 779-1554 [email protected] 3111 Camino Del Rio North Suite 423 San Diego, CA 92108
The Shareholders Foundation, Inc. is a professional portfolio legal monitoring and a settlement claim filing service, which does research related to shareholder issues and informs investors of securities class actions, settlements, judgments, and other legal related news to the stock/financial market. The Shareholders Foundation, Inc. is not a law firm. Any referenced cases, investigations, and/or settlements are not filed/initiated/reached and/or are not related to Shareholders Foundation. The information is only provided as a public service. It is not intended as legal advice and should not be relied upon.
